pattern: Native <input type="file"> opened by a native <button>; the drop zone is an enhancement (WCAG 2.5.7: dragging is never required).

roles.role: hidden; not in the tab order

aria.value: Label id and button-text id ("Attachments Choose files")
Help text, constraint hint, "Required", visible error, and rejection ids

keyboard.action: Moves between the chooser button and each remove button.
Removes the file; focus moves to the next remove button, else the previous one, else the chooser.

focus: The chooser button and remove buttons show a :focus-visible outline in color-focus-ring. After a drop, focus moves to the chooser button so the result is reachable.
notes: A button cannot carry aria-required, so "Required" is a visually hidden description.
Rejections are announced politely: "{file} was not added. {reason}" or "{count} files were not added."
Errors are text with an icon, never color alone.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
Native drag and drop has no keyboard equivalent by design; the chooser button is the keyboard and screen-reader path.
